items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Willie; the mention comes from the interviewer stating 'Willie also said that...'

ctx.x: But I think Willie also said that at that time McShann was not doing very well.

Well, McShann wasn't too happy because most of the time I had the band. In other words, McShann was being harrassed by the Army. I shouldn't say being har-rassed, but everytime you looked, they were calling him down for induction.
